harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: (وليال عشر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] A noun conjoined to «الفجر», genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ; the fatḥa was implied only because it stands in for the kasra; «عشر»: naʿt (adjective), genitive; and the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam) is omitted, i.e.: We will surely recompense everyone for what he did, as evidenced by His enumeration of what He did to the bygone generations.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «إذا»: a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of the oath; «يَسْرِ»: imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ; and the clause «يسر» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The preposition «في ذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «قسم»; «لذي» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «قسم»; and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «كيف فعل» stands in place of the two objects of the seeing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «التي»: naʿt (adjective) of {ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ}; the preposition «في البلاد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخلق».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: His saying «وثمود»: a noun conjoined to «عاد», genitive (majrūr) with fatḥa because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and feminine; «الذين»: naʿt (adjective); «بالواد»: a noun, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ; the preposition «بالواد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جابوا».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: His saying «وفرعون»: conjoined to «ثمود»; «ذي»: naʿt (adjective), genitive (majrūr).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «الذين»: naʿt (adjective) of «فرعون», with a muḍāf omitted, i.e.: the people of Pharaoh.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «فأكثروا» is conjoined to the clause {طَغَوْا}.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «فصبَّ» is conjoined to the clause «أكثروا».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: (إن ربك لبالمرصاد) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «أما»: a particle of condition and detailing; the conditional clause is parenthetical; «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the implied apodosis; «ما»: redundant (zāʾida); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer of «أمَّا», which is the khabar (predicate) of «الإنسان»; the clause «فيقول» is the khabar of «الإنسان», and the fāʾ is the linking one; «أكرمن»: past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, the nūn is that of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: (وأما إذا ما ابتلاه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي أهانن) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the preceding one; the mubtadaʾ (subject) after «أمَّا» is implied (muqaddar), and the i'rab is as given in the previous verse.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: (كلا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «حبا»: a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), so it is nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq (substitute for the absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَتَذَكَّرُ}; «دكا دكا»: two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being: the pounding being repeated upon it, as in "I taught him arithmetic chapter by chapter"; the second is not tawkīd (emphasis).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «صفًا صفًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: standing in ranks; and the clause «جاء» is conjoined to {دُكَّتِ}.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «وجيء» is conjoined to the clause {دُكَّتِ}, and the preposition «بجهنم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «يومئذ»: badal (substitute) of {إِذَا}; the second «يومئذ»: badal of the first; and the clause «يتذكر» is the apodosis (jawāb) of {إِذَا} in verse (21). The wāw in «وأنى» is parenthetical; «أنى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb meaning "from where", attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «الذكرى» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «له» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذكرى».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «يقول» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the clause {يَتَذَكَّرُ}; «يا» is for alerting (tanbīh).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «يومئذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعذب»; «أحد» is a fāʿil (agent) placed later

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «وثاقه» is nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq (substitute for the absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «ارجعي» is the answer to the vocative, resumptive; «راضية مرضية» are two ḥāls (circumstantials).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «فادخلي» is conjoined to the clause {ارْجِعِي}.
